notes.title: Version 1.21 update content

Optimize the login interface function
Fix more known problems

notes.title: Questions about the DLC 富庶农桑 - 报恩塔
notes.content: The DLC 富庶农桑 - 报恩塔 has been removed from the main application. Players who need it can purchase it separately. If you encounter the prompt: "The Repaying Tower shows that the network connection failed", it may be that you have not purchased this DLC module. It will bring you Sorry for the inconvenience.

notes.title: V1.20 version update content

[/list]
